title: Adobe Marketing Agent: campaign and audience analysis for a leadership review
source_category: Official worked scenario for a planned Agent 365 partner integration
availability: Adobe Marketing Agent integration coming soon, as stated by Microsoft
overview: Microsoft describes a marketing director preparing a leadership review by querying page views, orders and audience trends from Adobe Experience Platform, then analyzing campaign-journey fallout and conflicts inside Microsoft Copilot.
published_facts: The worked scenario queries top-page views, orders by category and audience-size trends.
The director performs loyalty-campaign fallout analysis and reviews campaign conflicts.
Microsoft describes query and dataset-access telemetry flowing through Agent 365 and Purview.
The Adobe Marketing Agent integration is explicitly marked coming soon.

sources.title: Ecosystem partner agents available in Agent 365 - Adobe example scenarios
sources.verification: Primary page and marketing-director worked scenario fetched and read directly.

a365_relationship: Direct but planned: the source explicitly links Adobe Marketing Agent to Agent 365 observability and Purview.
intent: Prepare a marketing leadership review from page views, orders, audience trends, journey fallout and campaign-conflict analysis.
actors: Marketing director, Adobe Marketing Agent and IT observer; Agent abstracts the analysis workflow.
published_outcome: Published intended marketing-analysis workflow; no real campaign was queried and no conversion improvement is established.

actions.description: Query page views, orders and audience-size trends from Experience Platform.
Analyze fallout in the campaign journey.
Review conflicts relevant to campaign performance.
Prepare the resulting insights for the leadership review.

local_assumptions: The workflow is serialized for the local model; the source does not publish a tool-call protocol.
Independent approval before presenting the final review is an added local policy.
A prepared review is an output milestone, not a proof of correct causal explanation for conversion changes.
limitations: The integration is marked coming soon and no live Adobe datasets were accessed.
SkillC cannot validate campaign metrics, causal analysis or the accuracy of the presentation.
Actual Purview/Agent 365 telemetry ingestion remains unverified.

runtime_model.source_fixture: Synthetic campaign metric and journey snapshot.
